description: This file defines controller functions for managing NVIDIA NIM containers via an Express.js server, including token retrieval, container preload, download, image pull, start, get image/container info, list containers, and stop container.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Handles OAuth token retrieval from NVIDIA's service using axios POST request.

methods.name: preload
methods.description: Preloads the NVIDIA NIM container environment.

methods.name: pullImage
methods.description: Pulls a container image based on provided imageTag and apiKey.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container with specified imageTag, apiKey, hostPort, and memory constraints.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific image by imageTag.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Retrieves container info for a given imageTag and port, checking if container exists and port is in use.
